random_seed: fixed seeds: probes A/B use seeds 0..5, probe C uses seeds 100..105; power-law input drawn with np.random.default_rng(7); mean +/- std reported across seeds

outputs.metric: decisive_powerlaw_subcritical[0] (g=0.3): alpha under power-law input at subcritical g
outputs.tolerance: alpha within +/-0.15 of 1.0 at lambda_max=-1.856 (sd 0.0054 across 6 seeds); falsifier(3) fires

outputs.metric: decisive_powerlaw_subcritical[2] (g=0.8): alpha under power-law input at subcritical g
outputs.tolerance: alpha within +/-0.15 of 1.0 at lambda_max=-0.897 (sd 0.0035 across 6 seeds); subcritical alpha~1 confirmed

outputs.metric: g_sweep_spearman_lambda_alpha (monotone alpha(lambda_max) across g,seed, fixed low-dim input)
outputs.tolerance: Spearman <= -0.9 (monotone decreasing alpha vs lambda WITHIN a fixed input ensemble; scoped sufficiency only)

outputs.metric: input_axis.spearman_sigma_lambda at fixed g=1.5 (input statistics sweep lambda over a wide range while alpha stays in a narrow band off the g-curve)
outputs.tolerance: lambda_max ranges -0.53..+0.03 across sigma_in while alpha stays ~1.5-2.6 and does NOT track the g-calibrated alpha(lambda) curve; alpha is not a function of lambda alone

known_limitations: Toy tanh recurrent reservoir, NOT cortical data and NOT trained task networks. Lyapunov exponent estimated from a single renormalised tangent vector (leading exponent only). alpha is a log-log slope of the covariance eigenspectrum over ranks [3, N/2], sensitive to the fit window and to spectral degeneracy (flagged by participation ratio PR). The g-sweep monotone alpha(lambda_max) holds only WITHIN a fixed low-dimensional input ensemble; it does not generalise across input statistics (probe B shows input is a second independent axis). The decisive probe C shows that supercriticality is NOT necessary for alpha~1 (power-law input geometry yields alpha~1 at lambda_max<0), but a random untrained reservoir cannot speak to trained biological networks or to the seed paper's DMFT/cortical measurement; it establishes only that the dynamical route is sufficient-and-scoped, not necessary or exclusive.
